facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹1.08 lakh cr, +17% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹2,048 cr, +8% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹24,437 cr (+18% YoY), PAT ₹522 cr (+16% YoY).
Revenue has compounded at 19% over 10 years, 7% over 5 and 12% over 3; the last twelve months (+17%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (12% vs 12%).
Borrowings are ₹3,099 cr against equity of ₹19,468 cr: debt/equity 0.16× (was 0.07× in Mar 2023).
The cash conversion cycle is 0 days, little changed from 0 in Mar 2023.
Promoters hold 50.5%, +0.3 pp over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 18.8%, −6.1 pp over a year.

Operating cash flow is not a useful quality test for an insurer — premiums received and claims paid flow through it. Judge earnings quality on solvency, embedded value and persistency, which the headline financials do not carry.
The effective tax rate was only 10% in Sep 2026, which flatters PAT.

claims.claim: Individual weighted received premium grew 11%, ahead of the private industry at 10%, with market share improving 10bps to 16.2% in Q2.
claims.quote: In Q2, individual weighted received premium grew 11%, ahead of the private industry at 10%, with market share improving 10bps to 16.2% in Q2.

claims.claim: New business margin was 24.7%, compared with 24.5% in H1 FY2026, driven by strong product mix and mitigation of GST impact.
claims.quote: New business margin was 24.7%, compared with 24.5% in H1 FY2026. The improvement was driven by a strong product mix and the continued mitigation of the GST impact

claims.claim: Solvency ratio stood at 180% as of September 30, 2026, well above the regulatory requirement of 150%.
claims.quote: Our solvency ratio stood at 180% as of September 30, 2026, well above the regulatory requirement of 150%.

claims.claim: New business margins stood at 25%, aided by better product profile, which helped absorb scale-related pressure and a GST impact of approximately 60 basis points.
claims.quote: New business margins stood at 25%, aided by better product profile, which helped absorb scale-related pressure and a GST impact of approximately 60 basis points.

claims.claim: Our retail private market share stood at 16.3%.
claims.quote: our retail private market share stood at 16.3%.

claims.claim: Business through the HDFC Bank channel remains subdued this quarter, reflecting softer volumes at the overall bank level.
claims.quote: Business through the HDFC Bank channel remains subdued this quarter, reflecting softer volumes at the overall bank level.

claims.claim: Most of the competition is now completely benign on those products, which were obviously not profitable for them as well.
claims.quote: Most of the competition is now completely benign on those products, which were obviously not profitable for them as well.

claims.claim: The margin drop in FY26 was driven by GST/surrender value impact, fixed cost absorption, and persistency assumption strengthening.
claims.quote: This margin drop was driven by three key factors. First, the impact of GST and surrender value of 130 basis points. Second, the fixed cost absorption impact of 90 basis points... and third, 40 basis points

claims.claim: Retail protection grew 43% in FY26, supported by lower prices post-GST and a strengthened product portfolio.
claims.quote: Protection was a clear highlight during the year, with a growth of 43% supported by lower prices post-GST and a strengthened product portfolio.

claims.claim: The company's private sector market share stood at 15.2% for 11 months of FY26.
claims.quote: Our private sector market share stood at 15.2% for 11 months FY26.

claims.claim: The company plans to raise up to INR 1,000 crores via preferential issue to HDFC Bank to boost solvency.
claims.quote: we have taken board approval to raise up to INR1,000 crores by way of a preferential issue to our parent, HDFC Bank. This will add 900 basis points to our current solvency.

claims.claim: The life insurance sector saw an acceleration in momentum during the third quarter, supported by recent policy reforms and a rising preference for protection-led solutions.
claims.quote: The life insurance sector saw an acceleration in momentum during the third quarter, supported by recent policy reforms and a rising preference for protection-led solutions.

claims.claim: While a better product profile helped us expand margins by 110 basis points, there was an offset largely on account of GST impact.
claims.quote: While a better product profile helped us expand margins by 110 basis points, there was an offset largely on account of GST impact.

claims.claim: The impact of the new Labor Codes amounts to Rs. 98 crores and has been reflected in embedded value relating to services rendered up to 31st December 2025.
claims.quote: The impact of the new Labor Codes amounts to Rs. 98 crores and has been reflected in embedded value relating to services rendered up to 31st December 2025.

claims.claim: The solvency ratio remained strong at 180%, supported by the Rs. 749 crores of subordinated debt raised in Q3.
claims.quote: The solvency ratio remained strong at 180%, supported by the Rs. 749 crores of subordinated debt raised in Q3.

claims.claim: Individual APE grew 10% YoY, resulting in a 90 bps increase in overall market share to 11.9% and 30 bps gain in private market share.
claims.quote: Individual Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE) grew 10% year-on-year... resulting in a 90 bps increase in overall market share to 11.9%, and a 30 bps gain in private market share to 16.6% for H1FY26.

claims.claim: New business margin in H1 prior to factoring GST was 25%, and post-GST was broadly at FY25 levels at 24.5%.
claims.quote: New business margin in H1 prior to factoring the GST impact was 25%. Post GST, new business margin for H1 was broadly at FY25 levels, at 24.5%.

claims.claim: Profit after tax in H1 rose 9% YoY to Rs 994 crore, and AUM crossed the Rs 5 trillion milestone.
claims.quote: Profit after tax in H1, rose 9% YoY to ₹994 crore. Embedded Value stood at ₹59,540 crore... Assets Under Management (AUM)... has crossed the ₹5 trillion milestone

claims.claim: Retail protection grew 27% YoY, and post-GST changes, retail protection growth was more than 50% in September.
claims.quote: Retail protection grew 27% YoY, outpacing overall company growth... on retail protection, growth post GST changes was more than 50% in the month of September.

claims.claim: Individual APE grew 12.5% YoY (2-year CAGR 21%), outperforming the industry and private sector and boosting overall market share by 70 bps to 12.1%.
claims.quote: Individual Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE) grew by 12.5% year-on- year, translating into a robust 2-year CAGR of 21%. We outperformed both the overall industry and the private sector, resulting in a 70 bps increase in our market share

claims.claim: VNB for Q1 FY26 was ₹809 crore, up 12.7% YoY with new business margins steady at 25.1%.
claims.quote: Value of New Business (VNB) for Q1 FY26 stood at ₹ 809 crore, a growth of 12.7% YoY and a 2-year CAGR of 15%, with new business margins steady at 25.1%.

claims.claim: Solvency remains robust at 192% and Embedded Value increased to Rs. 58,355 crore.
claims.quote: Solvency remains robust at 192%. Profit after tax grew 14% to Rs. 546 crore, driven by a 15% growth in back-book profits. Renewal collections registered robust growth of 19% YoY. Persistency metrics remained healthy... Embedded Value increased to Rs. 58,355 crore
